$comment: Voice samples the catalog's tts voices play (#2156, #2239). `base_url` is the one public address every deployment plays them from; a sample key in config/models/tts/models.yaml is a path under it and names its language by the segment after the model (voice-samples/<model>/<lang>/<voice>.mp3; none means en). `languages` gives the sentence each language says; `extra_body` adds what one model takes beyond its text and voice, with {boost} standing for the language's `boost`. `pnpm voice-samples` makes the samples that address does not serve yet. The same address serves the camera command preview clips the video catalog names (camera_commands[].sample_key in config/models/video/models.yaml), which the same command makes with the model and then shrinks to a silent 640-wide clip that starts playing before it has fully arrived.
